messages:
anya (People Ops): Heads-up: we're launching the "Policy Acknowledgement + Quick Refresher" flow next week. Purpose: explicit acks in onboarding, automated tracking for HRIS, and a short 10-min refresher for data handling and benefits. Deadline for current staff: Jun 30.

sam (People Ops): New flow highlights: section-level ack (Benefits, Data, Code of Conduct), optional 3-question quiz for Data. Fail twice -> auto-enroll to 15-min remedial training and manager notification.

mira (Recruiting): For offers: do we want new hires to ack before access requests or within 7 days? We need to pick one for offer language.

anya (People Ops): Default: within 7 days. Data-handling ack required before requesting infra credentials (automated gate). We'll add a manual override for urgent hires with a short exception form.

cody (HRIS): I need the CSV schema for nightly sync: user_id, manager_id, section_ack_list, ack_ts, quiz_score, reg_data_flag, source. hr-bot, can you create the export path?

hr-bot: Export created: /internal/hr/exports/policy_ack_2026-06-01.csv next run 2026-06-01T03:00Z :robot_face:

owen (Eng Manager): Concern: if the ack email lands in spam and infra access is gated, new hires may be blocked. Can we allow a 48-hour grace or let infra owners approve with a note?

anya (People Ops): Yes — 48-hour grace + manual override by infra owner with a reason logged. We'll capture that in the access request workflow.

mira (Recruiting): Offer blurb suggestion: "Please complete the Policy Acknowledgement within your first 7 days. Some access requests depend on the Data Handling ack."

sam (People Ops): I'll route the final ack wording to legal for sign-off. Also scheduling manager reminders: first nudge Jun 16, final nudge Jun 28. Template DM: "Reminder: please confirm your team's Policy Acks by Jun 30. Link: <tracker>. Contact people-ops for exceptions."

cody (HRIS): I'll produce per-manager missing lists after the final run and send via CSV. Need managers to ensure manager_id is current in HRIS.

anya (People Ops): Good. We'll also update the handbook with a short decision tree for exceptions and vendor-managed contractors — PR will be posted in the handbook repo. I'll post a mid-cycle status on Jun 20 with completion rates.

owen (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll tell my new hires to expect the ack in day 1 and warn infra owners about the 48-hour override.

hr-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by hr-bot

anya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — ping me for edge cases or if you need CSV samples.
